theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr <;> rename_i hb
  case' choice =>
    constructor <;> intro s' ht <;> cases ht <;> rename_i ht
  case' bisim => constructor <;> intro s' ht
  case left.choiceR | right.choiceR =>
    exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  all_goals
    first
    | refine (hb.follow_fst ht).elim ?_
    | refine (hb.follow_snd ht).elim ?_
    rintro t ⟨ht, hh⟩
    refine ⟨t, ?_, ChoiceBisim.bisim hh⟩
    first | exact ht | exact Tr.choiceL ht
